notes.title: Linux Translation Issues
notes.notes:
We are aware of issues on Linux where translations don't show up, for now you can switch to the Nightly beta branch on Steam as a fix was pushed 2 weeks ago after release 0.8.6 was sliced. 

We'll be slicing a 0.8.7 soon with more bugfixes and the like, including the translation fix! 🦊
